payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute for each color a table of max substring length for each exact number of replacements by enumerating all substrings O(n^2 per color).
payload.rationale: The solution iterates over all intervals [l,r] to count matching characters and updates ans[color][length-matches] with max length, constructing a DP-like table indexed by cost. This mirrors interval DP table filling without recurrence merging, but the top-scoring candidate subtype is dp_interval.
